payload.name: pc-check-channel-list
payload.description: Pure-logic validator that inspects a raw candidate channel list and returns an explicit invalid-result object. Accepts a list, including an empty list, whose items are exact integers 0..255 inclusive; rejects bool, float, null, missing and wrong types. Returns {ok:boolean, channels:original list if valid else []}. No exceptions, imports, host calls, I/O or coercion.
